0.reason: A marker can be removed in any heavy-test file, and that is checked repo-wide by the slow-marker policy, not per file. The collection log records the deselection.

findings.text: no test asserts the heavy four stay deselected under addopts's '-m not slow' filter (pyproject.toml:282), so deleting the marker would redden nothing; the guard is the recorded one-time collection log collection-after-not-slow.log, not an assertion.

raw_text:
VERDICT goal: the source node's goal is a batched wall-edge polish, and the commit gained since the prior review at 4d3586580 is 5c998eea6, which adds only '@pytest.mark.slow' at tests/test_wall_events_batched.py:137 and touches no production code.
VERDICT done_when: the source done_when asks for a 1e-13 edgewise comparison at four 550-cell states, a failing bracket-clip control, five paired suite files with no added failures and one H200 table; the gained commit preserves every numerical assertion unchanged and the manifest records the paired arms at baseline-suite.log and after-suite.log, each completed=true with failure_count=0 and EXIT=0.
VERDICT write_paths: the source prompt declares nova/equilibrium/topology.py, tests/test_wall_events_batched.py, scripts/prototypes/bank_wall_events, docs/evidence/fragments/sub-millisecond-forward-path/bank-wall-events.html and a figures directory; git show 5c998eea6 --stat lists exactly one file, tests/test_wall_events_batched.py, inside that scope.
VERDICT manifest: read; status is complete, the checkpoint states the repair precisely (one slow decorator over four physical cases, logs EXIT=0, no test bodies executed), commits ends at 5c998eea6, and its claimed collection counts reconcile with the logs it names.
VERDICT diff: read the one commit against 4d3586580; it is a single added line placing @pytest.mark.slow above test_certificate_wall_events_match_edgewise, whose module-scoped physical_case fixture is parametrized limited/diverted and whose own parametrization is trial/converged, giving the four heavy ids and leaving test_seed_brackets_and_candidate_order and test_wall_edges_share_one_polish_program unmarked.
CALL_SITES: nova/equilibrium/topology.py:3376
SCORE goal_fidelity: 20
JUSTIFICATION goal_fidelity: tests/test_wall_events_batched.py:137 is the whole change and it answers the prior blocking finding at the same line, marking the four 550-cell cases slow while the two light tests stay in the default lane.
SCORE evidence: 19
JUSTIFICATION evidence: the defect is reproduced before the repair at collection-before-not-slow.log (6 tests collected at 4d3586580) and the repair is shown at collection-after-not-slow.log (2 of 6, 4 deselected) and collection-after-all.log (6 of 6), all EXIT=0 with the selected ids in collection-receipt.json.
SCORE scope_discipline: 20
JUSTIFICATION scope_discipline: git show 5c998eea6 --stat reports 1 file changed, 1 insertion, confined to tests/test_wall_events_batched.py.
SCORE durability: 15
JUSTIFICATION durability: the four heavy tests still run under -m 'slow or not slow' per collection-after-all.log, but nothing at tests/test_wall_events_batched.py:137 fails if the marker is removed, so the default lane's protection is a recorded measurement rather than an assertion.
SCORE fit: 20
JUSTIFICATION fit: @pytest.mark.slow is the repository's own mechanism, declared at pyproject.toml:287 and used the same way by the sibling heavy suites at tests/equilibrium/test_certificate_550_convergence.py:51.
SCORE reuse: 20
JUSTIFICATION reuse: the change adds no definition, module or helper, and uses the pytest marker the repository already owns rather than introducing a parallel skip mechanism.
FINDING tests/test_wall_events_batched.py:137 non-blocking: no test asserts the heavy four stay deselected under addopts's '-m not slow' filter (pyproject.toml:282), so deleting the marker would redden nothing; the guard is the recorded one-time collection log collection-after-not-slow.log, not an assertion.
